def gauss(A):

    return A.real.astype(np.int64),A.imag.astype(np.int64)


def gm(A,B):

def pauli(word):

    P=np.ones((1,1),complex)
    for c in word:P=np.kron(P,one[c])

def syndrome(word,stabilizers):
